scope: Goals, experience and review together as one complete window after merged PR #36.
background_strategy: Reuse the existing PixelLab guild entrance and native controls.
visual_review: Three separate complete landscape screens; readable Spanish with no visible clipping or overlap.
Shared header, panel, background composition and native control language.
Adult goal order and experience choices match the existing catalog.
Goal and experience examples agree with the summary; selected values are fictional.
Background and controls in the concepts are references only; use original independent native assets at runtime.
implementation_constraints: No runtime code changed in the concept stage.
Use the existing goal and experience identifiers; do not change the training algorithm.
Real initial selections are empty; keyboard focus does not choose an option.
Uncertainty requires explicit confirmation of a beginner starting point; cancel preserves prior selection.
Teen review offers general_fitness and mobility; unknown age does not grant adult eligibility.
Body appearance and measurements never infer experience or goal.
Existing profile pause, age, consent and production authorization boundaries remain active.
Choosing intermediate does not automatically unlock Hard; difficulty stays adjustable during the routine within existing rules.
Review data stays in memory; no profile save, workout generation or Home entry is established.
Back, document visits and locale changes preserve the draft; exit/reset discards it.
Next destination is available equipment, then schedule/session length.
